summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Himax Technologies, Inc., a foreign private issuer, to provide the notice of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for August 12, 2026, along with the related proxy statement. The filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure required under home-country rules; no special situation event is present. Shareholders will vote on adopting 2025 financial statements and re-electing an independent director. There are no terms, prices, or recommendations suggesting any special situation category.
